query: UPDATE webhook_deliveries SET next_attempt_at = $2 + make_interval(secs => $3) WHERE id IN (SELECT d.id FROM webhook_deliveries d JOIN webhook_subscriptions s ON s.id = d.subscription_id WHERE d.status = 'pending' AND d.next_attempt_at <= $2 AND s.enabled ORDER BY d.next_attempt_at, d.id LIMIT $1 FOR UPDATE OF d SKIP LOCKED) RETURNING id
